sub_site: plasma cell-free DNA (gastric cancer and benign participants)

evidence.quote: resulting in final analytical cohorts of 870 participants
All samples underwent cfDNA whole genome sequencing and were analyzed.
filtered reads were aligned to NCBI microbial genomes using Kraken2

controls.types: blank control (1 ml distilled water) per batch

evidence.quote: blank controls of 1 ml distilled water were used in every batch of the experiment to control the microbial DNA contamination from environment and reagents
Sequences identified by blank controls were excluded as contamination.

decontamination.tool: exclusion of sequences found in blank controls; read/k-mer thresholds

evidence.quote: Sequences identified by blank controls were excluded as contamination.

notes: Plasma cfDNA low-depth WGS (2x) mined with Kraken2/Bracken for a gastric-cancer diagnostic model. Only two genera named in text (K. pneumoniae enriched in GC, S. maltophilia in benign); 75 LEfSe species in Supplementary Data 2 (not available). '30 control samples per batch' are batch-effect reference samples, not negative controls.
